name: Truth Beneath the Shadows
source:
Grimsborough, once a peaceful town, is now being consumed by the dark shadows of a new power. When William Caulfield, an influential businessman and key supporter of clean energy projects, mysteriously disappears.

You'll take on the roles of Max and Sam, independent journalists dedicated to uncovering the truth, hired by Lydia after receiving mysterious tips about this case. Their investigation leads them to discover the dark underbelly of Vincent Syndicate (V-Capital), a rising investment group that's growing rapidly but conceals secrets and illegal activities.

The deeper they dig, the more dangerous the truth becomes. Clues from William's phone, tampered security cameras, and confidential information from former Syndicate insiders point to a mystery called "Protocol-14" and a forbidden location known as "Warehouse 14."

Are you ready to risk your life to expose the truth hidden beneath the shadows of Grimsborough?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3716120/Truth_Beneath_the_Shadows/]Steam[/url]]
